entities.name: British Empiricism
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A philosophical tradition holding that knowledge comes primarily from sensory experience. Its principal figures — John Locke, George Berkeley, and David Hume — argued against innate ideas and shaped epistemology, political philosophy, and the scientific method.
